Literally everything you’ve been looking for to block out doomscrolling.  
Enable the settings like “Allow opening the real app” & “Hide Reels”.

It is quite literally everything you can ask for to block poisonous social media doomscrolling traps.  And did I mention….FOR FREE?!

The ScreenZen team definitely deserves a tip on their free app.  Drop a quick fiver for them as they’re doing what no one will.

God bless the ScreenZen team, quite literally saving lives out here, and thats not over exaggerated.

reviews.title: Loved it but then they updated
reviews.text: This app was awesome. But then they released the new update that causes a lot of crashes while in the Settings mode. Particularly when I am trying to change the lock timer features. It seems a little bit like a step away from just simple zen app with the new update. Hopefully this gets resolved and would review it again.

reviews.title: 672-day streak!
reviews.text: For 672 days straight this app has seriously helped me cut down on my screentime. I used to be regularly over 4 hrs of screentime a day, now I’m down half that. It helps me have a few minutes of scroll time and actually STICK to those few minutes. Then I can get on with my day. Highly recommend
